# Pawpon: Cat Capsule Shop

> Work the night shift at a tiny capsule-toy shop, work the claw machines and fill your shelves with collectible cats. Real odds before every pull. Free on Android.

Pawpon is a cozy first-person collecting game for Android by Ludilume, the one-person studio of Talha Abid in Pakistan. You work the night shift at a small capsule-toy (gachapon) shop: do jobs around the shop to earn tokens, work the claw machines in first person, open the capsule, and put each cat on a shelf in your bedroom.

## Facts

- Platform: Android, on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pawpon
- Price: free to play, with optional in-app purchases
- Current version: 1.1.2
- Engine: Godot. Single player, plays offline, English.
- Cats: 42 collectible cats in 7 sets (Kitty Cakes; If I Fits, I Sits; Cats vs Cucumbers; Meme Meownia; Loaf Legends; Astro Whiskers; Afterglow Companions)
- Pulls cost tokens, and tokens are only earned by playing. They are never sold.
- The store sells currencies with stated contents, used to unlock and upgrade cabinets or to pick a specific cat. Every cabinet's odds, at every upgrade level, are published: https://talhaabidj.github.io/odds/
- Pity guarantees at 25, 60, 120 and 240 pulls.
- Every model, texture and sound in the game is generated by code written for Pawpon.
- Developer page: https://play.google.com/store/apps/developer?id=Ludilume
- Contact: talhaabidj1@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Community guidelines](https://talhaabidj.github.io/community/): Pawpon's community guidelines for Discord and fan spaces, plus the fan content policy for streams, videos, fan art and mods.
- [Credits and licences](https://talhaabidj.github.io/credits/): Credits for Pawpon and the open-source software and typefaces it uses, with their licences: Godot Engine, RevenueCat, Google Play services and more.
- [Delete your Pawpon account and data](https://talhaabidj.github.io/delete-data/): Delete your Pawpon account and cloud save in the app, or request deletion by email. What is deleted, what is kept and for how long, for the Pawpon Android app by Ludilume.
- [Odds and fair play](https://talhaabidj.github.io/odds/): Pawpon's published drop rates for every capsule cabinet, the pity guarantees at 25, 60, 120 and 240 pulls, upgrade effects, and what the store sells.
- [Press kit](https://talhaabidj.github.io/press/): Pawpon press kit: fact sheet, game description, key features and press contact details.
- [Privacy policy](https://talhaabidj.github.io/privacy/): How Pawpon handles your data: your account and cloud save, what stays on your device, what Google Play, Firebase, RevenueCat and Google AdMob receive, your rights, and how to delete your account.
- [Help and FAQ](https://talhaabidj.github.io/support/): Pawpon help: restoring purchases, refunds, moving to a new phone, performance tips, the claw dropping capsules, and how to reach the developer.
- [Terms of service](https://talhaabidj.github.io/terms/): The terms for playing Pawpon: your licence, in-game currencies and purchases, refunds, odds, fair play, and how disputes are handled.
